g.text: Point-cloud fields; shared color ranges for A0 and A2
Blue outlines: end-plane z-controlled nodes (x/y free). Other nodes: all DOFs free.
Green dashed lines mark the declared reference crack fronts; no continuous crack shell is synthesized.
